note: An experiment (GAME_SPEC §13.7, Stage 52; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 13) on data/benches/titration.json: a titration. H2SO4 + 2 NaOH -> Na2SO4 + 2 H2O: the acid's concentration = 0.100 x V(base) / (2 x 25.00).
title: Experiment: a titration

steps.title: Fill the burette
steps.text: Pick up the sodium hydroxide, right-click the burette, type 55 and click "pour". Right-click the burette and write down its reading.
steps.why: A burette reads down from its zero line near its top, to 0.01 mL by eye between its 0.1 mL lines. What it reads first is subtracted from what it reads at the end: the base you ran in.

steps.title: 25 mL of the acid
steps.text: Pick up the pipette and click the acid: it draws up to its mark.
steps.why: The pipette delivers 25.00 mL within 0.03 mL: the acid you titrate.

steps.title: Into the flask
steps.text: Pick up the pipette again and click the flask: it stands in its neck and runs into it.

steps.title: Until it is empty
steps.text: Wait until the pipette has run out.

steps.title: The burette over the flask
steps.text: Pick up the pipette and click a free square. Then pick up the burette and click the flask: its tip stands in the flask's neck.

steps.title: Open the tap
steps.text: Right-click the burette, drag its tap fully open, and click 60x on the clock. Watch the flask's pH meter.
steps.why: The base neutralises the acid as it runs in: H2SO4 + 2 NaOH -> Na2SO4 + 2 H2O. The pH hardly moves while acid is left over, so the start can run fast.

steps.title: Nearly there
steps.text: Watch the pH climb past 2.2: little acid is left.

steps.title: Drop by drop
steps.text: Open the tap a little, to about 5 %, and watch the pH meter.
steps.why: Near the end point a drop changes the pH by units: the base slowly, so as not to run past it.

steps.title: Shut it, read it
steps.text: Drag the tap shut and write down the burette's reading.
steps.why: The base run in is the end's reading less the start's. In moles, 0.100 mol/L times that volume; the acid's are half of them, in 25.00 mL.

results.label: the acid's sulfuric acid in 25 mL (the truth: what was pipetted)
